en: years from now, we'll be saying,▼"I sure am glad I learned THAT▼in school!"

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;At least, that's what my mon▼always says!
$024'327'0;$023'327'178'10'1;$022'327'361;Do you ever just sit at your▼desk and not do any studying?

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;You know, just space out,▼thinking of nothing at all?

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'178'10'1;$022'327'361;What kind of job do you want to▼do when you grow up?
A job I like!$019'37;

en: A well-paid job!$019'38;

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;You first have to pick a job▼you'd like to do and then figure▼out how to get that job.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Trước tiên chọn nghề mình thích,▼rồi tìm xem làm sao▼theo đuổi nghề ấy.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;You can't waste time. You should▼be working hard for your future▼right now!
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Đừng phí thời gian!▼Từ giờ hãy cố gắng▼vì tương lai của cậu!

en: $024'327'6;$023'327'8'10'1;$022'327'382;You have to study really hard if▼you want money.
vi: $024'327'6;$023'327'8'10'1;$022'327'382;Muốn giàu có thì▼phải chăm học lắm đấy.

en: Only smart people get rich.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;There are as many kinds of jobs▼as stars in the night sky.

en: But most of us only know about▼the jobs our mom and dad do.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;I wish there was a class that▼told you about the different▼jobs in the world.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Ước gì trường có môn▼giới thiệu mọi ngành nghề▼trên thế giới.

en: That would really help us decide▼what kind of work we want to do▼when we grow up!

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;If all you do is work, then you▼won't have time for the other▼things in life.
vi: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;Nếu chỉ biết đi làm,▼cậu sẽ chẳng còn thời gian▼cho những chuyện khác.

en: Like hanging out with friends▼and stuff. I read that in a▼book.

en: Your friends will get lonely if▼you never have any time for▼them.
vi: Bạn bè sẽ cô đơn nếu▼cậu chẳng dành thời gian cho họ.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;It's important to make time for▼things other than work.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Ngoài công việc,▼cũng phải có thời gian cho▼những điều khác chứ.

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;My mother always says she'd▼rather I study than help out▼around the house.

en: But I can't help thinking that▼maybe I shouldn't spend ALL my▼time studying.

en: After school$019'44;

en: After dinner$019'45;

en: Come home and crack open the▼books right away.

en: Then later on you can just relax▼and do whatever.

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;Trying to study late at night▼just puts me straight to sleep.
$024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;I mean, trying to do your▼homework right after you've▼eaten doesn't work.
vi: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;Vừa ăn no xong▼mà làm bài tập ngay▼thì khó tập trung lắm.

en: I suggest you get it all done▼BEFORE dinner.
vi: Tớ khuyên cậu nên▼làm xong TRƯỚC bữa tối.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;The more interested you are in▼your studies, the better you'll▼do.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Càng hứng thú với bài học,▼cậu càng học tốt hơn.

en: Really, if you think about it,▼anything can be interesting.
vi: Nghĩ kỹ thì▼môn nào cũng có cái hay.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;And when you enjoy something,▼the time just flies by because▼you're having so much fun.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Khi đang vui, thời gian▼trôi nhanh vèo vèo ấy!

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;No matter what the subject, try▼to find something in it that▼interests you.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Môn nào cũng vậy, hãy thử▼tìm một điều khiến cậu thích.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;If you want to go on a diet, the▼best thing to do is fall in▼love.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Muốn giảm cân á?▼Tốt nhất là... phải lòng ai đó!

en: When you're in love, you just▼don't need to eat.

en: $024'327'7;$023'327'177'10'1;All you can think about is the▼person you're in love with.
vi: $024'327'7;$023'327'177'10'1;Trong đầu chỉ toàn▼hình bóng người mình thích.
$024'327'7;$023'327'170'10'2;$022'327'301;Con trai không nên▼đâm đầu vào yêu đương.

en: They forget about their school▼work, start staring off into▼space on the sports field...

$024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Vì tình yêu khiến▼con gái mạnh mẽ hơn.

en: $024'327'7;$023'327'177'10'1;Love turns boys into turnips.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;When you start to really like▼someone, you get interested in▼the same things they are.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Khi thích ai đó thật lòng,▼cậu cũng bắt đầu quan tâm▼những gì họ thích.

en: You try things out that you▼wouldn't normally think of▼trying.
vi: Cậu thử cả những thứ▼bình thường chưa từng nghĩ tới.

en: You end up getting into the same▼books and music and stuff as the▼person you like.

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;When you're in love, it's always▼hard to go to bed.
You're always too excited,▼thinking about the other▼person...
vi: Cứ háo hức nghĩ▼về người kia mãi thôi...

en: $024'327'7;$023'327'177'10'1;wondering if they're sleeping▼already, or if they're lying▼awake thinking about you.

en: $024'327'7;$023'327'170'10'2;$022'327'301;It's amazing people in love ever▼get any sleep at all!

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;When you're in love with▼someone, you even end up loving▼the bad things about them.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Khi yêu ai đó,▼cậu còn thương cả▼những tật xấu của họ.

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;But you shouldn't let yourself▼become too blinded by love.
vi: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;Nhưng đừng để▼tình yêu che mờ mắt nhé.

en: You might end up spending a lot▼of time with that person, so you▼need to use good judgment.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;When I find someone I like, I▼always want to do things for▼them.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Khi thích ai, tớ chỉ muốn▼làm gì đó cho họ thôi.

en: I'm not always like that.

en: $024'327'7;$023'327'177'10'1;But if I like the person...well,▼I just want to help out any way▼I can!

en: $024'327'2;$023'327'28'8'4;$022'327'381;When a couple goes for a stroll,▼the boy should always walk at▼the same speed as the girl.

en: It's no good to go running off▼ahead...

en: $024'327'2;$023'327'28'8'4;$022'327'381;and complain to her that she▼walks too slow.
vi: $024'327'2;$023'327'28'8'4;$022'327'381;rồi quay lại trách▼cô ấy đi chậm quá.

en: We girls don't like to be▼constantly running around.▼Especially on a date.

en: $024'327'2;$023'327'28'8'4;$022'327'381;So boys should always pay▼attention to how fast they're▼walking.
vi: $024'327'2;$023'327'28'8'4;$022'327'381;Nên các cậu con trai▼nhớ để ý tốc độ đi nhé.

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;There's nothing worse than▼keeping a date waiting.▼Especially on a first date!

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;The first time you go out, you▼have to make a special effort.

en: If you mess up the first date,▼then there won't be any more!

en: $024'327'6;$023'327'8'10'1;$022'327'382;You only get one chance at▼making a good first impression.
vi: $024'327'6;$023'327'8'10'1;$022'327'382;Ấn tượng đầu tiên▼chỉ có một lần thôi.

en: But you don't want to overdo it.

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;Because that can turn someone▼off just as fast!

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'178'10'1;$022'327'361;When you break up with someone,▼or when someone turns you down▼for a date, what do you do?

en: Become blue.$019'57;
vi: Buồn rầu.$019'57;

en: Stay cheerful.$019'58;
vi: Cứ vui vẻ.$019'58;

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;I actually think it's best if▼you let yourself feel really,▼really bad for a while.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Tớ nghĩ cứ cho phép mình▼buồn thật buồn một thời gian▼lại là cách tốt nhất.

en: Then you can get over it faster,▼and bounce back better than▼ever!

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;Ignoring your feelings won't▼make them go away, you know.
I think it's much better to just▼let yourself be sad for a while.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;It's a good idea to scout out▼locations for a date.

en: Think about where you want to▼go, what you want to do.
vi: Nghĩ xem mình muốn đi đâu,▼làm những gì.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Try to find out what the other▼person likes to do as well.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Cũng nên tìm hiểu xem▼người kia thích làm gì.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;A really good date takes a lot▼of planning!

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;January 7th is the Festival of▼Seven Herbs.
Eat rice porridge with these▼seven herbs and you'll be▼healthy all year long.

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;I often help my teachers out▼with various things.
vi: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;Tớ thường giúp thầy cô▼rất nhiều việc lặt vặt.

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;So guess who they always ask▼first when they need help?

en: I don't mind, of course. But▼sometimes I wish they'd call on▼someone else, you know?

en: It's easy enough to give someone▼a gift of chocolate.

en: $024'327'5;$023'327'175'8'1;$022'327'342;The worst thing is trying to▼remember who gave you what!
vi: $024'327'5;$023'327'175'8'1;$022'327'342;Khổ nhất là nhớ xem▼ai đã tặng mình món gì!

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Every spring at Easter, my▼grandmother and I would paint▼Easter eggs.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;she would give me a chocolate▼egg in exchange. Yum-yum!

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Whenever I see an egg, I always▼think of spring.

en: $024'327'7;$023'327'170'10'2;$022'327'301;Oh, dear. When spring comes, my▼nose gets SO itchy!

en: And recently, it's not just▼springtime, either.

en: I get the same thing in other▼seasons, too.

en: $024'327'7;$023'327'170'10'2;$022'327'301;My eyes get so itchy, it makes▼it very hard to concentrate on▼my studies.

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;In late spring, the flower▼blossoms start to fall.
It always makes me a little sad▼to see those flowers falling to▼the ground.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;But at the same time, they're so▼pretty fluttering through the▼air.
